notes.title: Update to version 0.0.31.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I’m happy to present the game update to version 0.0.31.

List of changes in the game:
[list]
[*] Added a new look for the character. The protagonist is now dressed in a cyber suit.
[*] Added a new look for the weapon with animation.
[*] Added a reset game progress button. It's available in the main menu without needing to load a level.
[/list]

notes.title: Update postponed.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

The development of my game project 'Number 8' is moving forward. Due to various factors, the release of the update is being postponed to September.
I'm pleased to share the progress of the update preparation. I've created a new 3D model of a blaster for the player character. I’ve gained additional experience and understanding in weapon design. I plan to create an assault rifle and a sniper rifle in the same style. 
How do you like this style?

notes.title: Announcement of the new update for version 0.0.31.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 I'm pleased to announce that an update to version 0.0.31 is planned for August. A new character suit will be added. Currently, the 3D model of the suit has been tested for correct UV map and skinning functionality. Work is ongoing on texturing and adding details. 
Additionally, with the update, the price of the game will be increased. If you were planning to save, now is the time to do so. 
A free demo version of the game will be added, featuring one of the already created levels.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.0.3
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!
I am glad to present to you the new update to version 0.0.3
List of changes in the game: 

[b]Levels[/b] 
[list]
[*] Added a new level - Laboratories. 
[*] Save points have been added to the level. You no longer have to start from the beginning of the level after death. 
[*] Redesigned the design of the initial tutorial level. The gameplay time on the level has increased threefold. 
[*] Improved design of the first and second levels (lighting, gameplay, optimization). 
[*] Redesigned the reactor room on the third level. New core design with additional gameplay elements.Lighting and gameplay aspects of the third level have been improved. 
[*] Added a corridor for easier access to the green key on the third level. 
[*] Changed the collision principle of the player with debris. The player no longer steps on debris (previously the player could stumble while walking on debris). 
[*] Glass and windows have been added. Now the player has the ability to assess the situation in the rooms. Unguarded glass can be shattered, allowing entry through the window. 
[*] New types of doors with gameplay elements (manual opening control and glass inserts) have been added. Now the player can close doors in front of enemies to escape. Glass doors allow observation without being noticed. The player can assess the situation behind the door and decide on the appropriate moment to attack. 
[*] New special effects added: cold steam, explosions, flickering light sources. 
[*] New environmental elements with physical properties have been added (tables, chairs, cabinets, shelves, computers, trash bins, boxes, crates). 
[*] The appearance of keys has been changed. They are now access cards lying on tables. 
[*] The design of the elevator has been improved. New sound effects for its operation, activation button, and the ability to go back have been added. 
[*] New environmental elements added: floor, ceiling, walls, windows, doors, columns, railings, and more. Player collision with cables has been disabled.
[/list]

[b]NPC[/b]
 
[list]
[*] The total number of enemies on levels has been increased. 
[*] Models of female enemies have been changed. 
[*] Models of male enemies have been added.

[i]New types of enemies added: [/i]
[*] Security guard with a shock baton (male) 
[*] Security guards with a blaster (male, female)
[*] Drone 

[i]New types of behaviors added: [/i]
[*] Guarding, 
[*] Random movement. 

[*] Enemies now have a visibility zone, and the player can move unnoticed. There's also an alarm time - if you're not detected for several seconds, the enemy will go about their business, ceasing to pursue you. Barrel design has been improved. The system for dealing damage to surroundings has been enhanced. The barrel explosion effect has been replaced. 
[*] Opening crates with health, energy, strength cores, weapon upgrades, and character upgrades have been added. 
[*] Two new turret designs created. Bugs fixed (laser now shines on character bodies, hanging turrets no longer glitch). Explosion effect replaced. 
[*] Two new mine designs created. A new type of mine added: falling and rolling. Explosion effect replaced.
[/list]

[b]Character and UI[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved appearance of the in-game character. 
[*] Character hair has been improved (physics and material). 
[*] Interface design has been improved (detailed character information removed from first-person mode and moved to the statistics section). 
[*] Visual confirmation of activities added: health regeneration, weapon recharging, use of time slowdown (animation in the interface). 
[*] Visual effect added when aiming from third-person view (aim appearance animation). 
[*] Improved effect when the player takes damage. 
[*] A button to access the graphics settings menu has been added to the main and game menus. 
[*] A bug that didn't save the display of selected settings has been fixed.
[*]  Game's musical arrangement redesigned. Old music canceled. Two new ambient-style musical pieces created and added. 
[*] A slider for controlling the overall game volume has been added to the sound menu. 
[*] Image post-processing improved (gamma correction, scene color work, cinematic highlights on chrome surfaces). 
[*] Global optimization work has been carried out. Game performance improved by 30%.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to version 0.0.3 is postponed by one day.
notes.content: The release of the update to version 0.0.3 is postponed by one day, to March 21, 2024.

notes.title: Prepared update to version 0.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The new update to version 0.0.3 is already prepared and undergoing final testing. The release date is scheduled for March 20, 2024.

Main changes:
[list]
[*] Created a new fourth level, Laboratories.
[*] Completely refreshed and expanded the initial level.
[*] Partially redesigned the first, second, and third levels.
[*] Lighting completely reworked.
[*] Added new environmental elements.
[*] Added new types of enemies with different behavior models.
[*] Music has been changed.
[*] Optimization has been improved.
[/list]
Watch new gameplay demonstrations and updates on the game's YouTube channel.

notes.title: A major update to version 0.0.25 is in progress.
notes.content: A major update to version 0.0.25 is in progress. A new level, enemies with different behavioral models, environmental details, and much more will be added.

notes.title: Update 0.0.24
notes.content:
Significantly improved lighting. (Lightmaps added) Now enemy targets are more visible. 
Performance has been enhanced. 
Added sound for block breaking.

notes.title: Update 0.0.232
notes.content:
Improved interface and its functionality. 
Added game top scores. 
Added new sounds.

notes.title: Update 0.0.231
notes.content:
First-person shooting has been fixed. Now the point of impact always aligns with the center of the target. 
Hit sound has been added. 
Shot sound has been modified. 
Improved target texture quality. 
Enhanced textures of the impact point.

notes.title: Update 0.0.23
notes.content:
Third-person shooting has been fixed. The point of impact no longer shifts and always aligns with the target's center.
Player hit traces have been added.

notes.title: Update 0.0.22
notes.content:
Added a flashlight on the first level. 
Improved flashlight lighting. Now it shines less brightly up close but twice as far.
Fixed loading after player's death. Now it shows an image of the loading level.
Added an alternative ending on the third level.
Added manually operated doors.
Added animation when changing character modes.
Updated the reactor scene.
Added color differentiation for enemies. Beware of red ones - they are more resilient and fire more intensively.
Added a Top Results table for comparison.

notes.title: Update 0.0.21
notes.content:
Added a time indicator spent on the level. 
Added a level completion results table. 
Improved turrets (animation, sound effects, added a new type). 
Fixed headshots on humanoids. (Previously, it didn't always register). 
Fixed enemy kills counting. (Previously, duplicate results occurred). 
Optimized the design of certain parts of the levels.

notes.title: Update v.0.0.17
notes.content:
Added a new game level. 
Added new gameplay objects. 
Added water with physical properties. You can safely jump if it's deep enough. 
Added Ukrainian and Russian language localizations. 
Added new environmental elements. 
Added new ambient sounds. 
Improved interface and menus. 
Changed musical arrangement.

notes.title: Update 0.0.161
notes.content:
Key remapping has been added. 
The bindings for the "use" key and the "super jump" have been swapped.

notes.title: Update 0.0.16
notes.content:
Added game difficulty level “Hard”. To activate, go to the game settings.
Improved Bullet time. When activated, the movement speed increases. Mouse sensitivity now does not change. Activation changed to Left CTRL key
Reduced power consumption on sprint.
Fixed mines. No longer deal damage through walls. Changed the principle and amount of damage dealt.
Changed damage from barrel explosion. Kills enemies within 2 meters radius.
Capsules with infinite energy and health regeneration canceled.
Added auto regeneration of energy and health up to 20 units.
Reduced the number of cores carried with you to 5 units.
Super jump now works only from third person.
Changed sounds of footsteps, low health level, picking up keys, picking up weapons.
Destroyed objects no longer recover.

notes.title: update 0.0.153
notes.content:
Expanded training on the first level.
The color code of the corridor lighting has been corrected to simplify the search for keys.
The design of the hall on the second level has been changed. A new element has been added.
